Test or inspection check: SRS expression semantics and native/LLVM verification

Observed result: Parser uses separate precedence levels and recursive assignment parsing. expression_native_test.cm checks multiplication precedence, parentheses, left-associative division/subtraction and right-associative chained assignment; negative cases reject invalid assignment targets.

Test or inspection check: SRS expression semantics and native/LLVM verification
Expected result: Every non-void expression yields int; comparisons, equality and logical expressions yield exactly 0 or 1; conditions test nonzero; !x yields 1 exactly when x is zero.
Observed result: Native expression checks verify comparison and logical results are exactly 0 or 1, !0 and !nonzero behavior, and logical conditions. LLVM lowering converts i1 comparison results to i32.

Test or inspection check: SRS expression semantics and native/LLVM verification
Expected result: Signed division truncates toward zero; remainder satisfies a == (a/b)*b + a%b for defined operands. Runtime tests avoid overflow, division by zero, INT_MIN/-1 and uninitialized reads.
Observed result: Native checks cover defined negative division and remainder combinations, including -7/3, 7/-3, -7%3, 7%-3 and -7%-3. LLVM lowering uses signed sdiv and srem. No undefined arithmetic case is relied upon as a passing runtime test.

Test or inspection check: SRS expression semantics and native/LLVM verification
Expected result: Logical && and || short-circuit; the right operand is not evaluated when the left operand determines the result, including right-side calls or assignment side effects.
Observed result: Native expression checks verify that the assignment on the right of false && and true || does not execute. LLVM IR verifier test assembles and verifies generated IR containing both short-circuit forms.

Test or inspection check: SRS expression semantics and native/LLVM verification
Expected result: Binary operands and call arguments evaluate left to right; each completed operand takes effect before the next; assignment evaluates its right operand before storing to its target.
Observed result: Native expression checks verify left-to-right binary side effects, left-to-right call-argument side effects, assignment result and RHS-before-store behavior, including a nested assignment on the RHS.

Test or inspection check: SRS expression semantics and native/LLVM verification
Expected result: Nested function calls, assignment expressions and expression statements preserve the selected sequencing order through student IR and backend IL; tests do not assume undefined behavior.
Observed result: Native expression checks cover nested pair calls, chained assignment, assignment expressions and expression statements. The native integration test runs the compiler-to-executable pipeline and checks the program exit status.

Test or inspection check: SRS expression semantics and native/LLVM verification
Expected result: All integer operations in lowered IR preserve signed 32-bit results for defined inputs; LLVM i32 is approved and int-valued boolean results are normalized to i32 0 or 1.
Observed result: LLVM lowering represents values and arithmetic as i32, uses signed sdiv/srem and signed comparisons, and zero-extends i1 comparison results to i32. Generated LLVM IR passes llvm-as-23 and opt-23 verification; native expression integration passes.
